exposure: Carpenter and Coustan (C&C) criteria for gestational diabetes (GDM)
International Association Diabetes Pregnancy Study Group (IADPSG) criteria
Pregnancies before implementation of IADPSG criteria (C&C cohort)
International Association Diabetes Pregnancy Study Group (IADPSG) criteria for GDM
Pregnancies after implementation of IADPSG criteria (IADPSG cohort)
cohort: All pregnancies in two separate 6-month cohorts in the province of British Columbia, Canada
finding: The implementation of the IADPSG criteria for gestational diabetes (GDM) resulted in higher rates of GDM diagnosis, but no significant changes in most maternal or fetal outcomes, except for an increase in neonatal hypoglycemia.
